description: Stable cross-user primary taxonomy for GitHub project portfolios. Implementation language, UI platform, repository artifact type, and ecosystem are separate facets rather than primary categories.

categories.label: AI & Machine Learning
categories.description: Machine learning, generative AI, computer vision, NLP, agents, model training, inference, and AI systems.

categories.label: Data & Analytics
categories.description: Data processing, databases, analytics, ETL, search, information retrieval, metrics, and data engineering.

categories.label: Visualization & Knowledge
categories.description: Information visualization, project maps, knowledge maps, graph exploration, dashboards, visual analytics, and structured knowledge browsing.

categories.label: Applications & Services
categories.description: End-user applications and network services whose primary purpose does not fit a more specific standard domain.

categories.label: Developer Tools
categories.description: Tools primarily used to build, test, debug, package, inspect, automate, or maintain software and developer workflows.

categories.label: Systems & Infrastructure
categories.description: Operating systems, runtimes, containers, cloud infrastructure, storage, observability, deployment, and low-level system software.

categories.label: Security & Privacy
categories.description: Security, privacy, authentication, authorization, cryptography, abuse prevention, malware analysis, and defensive tooling.

categories.label: Networking & Distributed Systems
categories.description: Networking, protocols, distributed systems, messaging, peer-to-peer systems, transport, RPC, and network services infrastructure.

categories.label: Hardware & Embedded
categories.description: Embedded systems, firmware, microcontrollers, device drivers, hardware integration, electronics, sensors, and IoT devices.

categories.label: Robotics & Automation
categories.description: Robotics, simulation, autonomous systems, manipulation, navigation, control, industrial automation, and robot middleware.

categories.label: Game Development
categories.description: Games, game engines, gameplay systems, interactive entertainment, simulations designed as games, and game-development tooling tightly coupled to game creation.

categories.label: Game Modding
categories.description: Mods, mod loaders, modding libraries, server gameplay extensions, compatibility layers, and tooling whose primary purpose is extending an existing game.

categories.label: Science & Engineering
categories.description: Scientific computing, engineering analysis, simulation outside game/robotics domains, mathematics, research software, and domain science tools.

categories.label: Education & Learning
categories.description: Educational software, tutorials, coursework, learning resources, teaching tools, exercises, and academic learning projects.

categories.label: Media & Creative
categories.description: Audio, video, graphics, image creation, design, animation, creative coding, publishing, and media-production software.

categories.label: Business & Productivity
categories.description: Business applications, productivity workflows, collaboration, commerce operations, personal organization, and office-oriented tools.
